title: The raw cohomology diagram and cocone
statement: For a commutative ring $\Lambda$, $k:W\to S$, a module sheaf $G$ on $W_{\mathrm{et}}$, $q\in\mathbf Z$, and an etale $U\to S$, let $R:\mathrm{Over}(W)^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathbf{Ab}$ send $A$ to $P_A(U)$ and $f^{\mathrm{op}}$ to $r_f$ from [sbc-lem-higher-image-raw-over-naturality]. Its well-definedness is [lem-sbc-higher-image-raw-pullback-functorial]. For a small diagram $D:I\to\mathrm{Over}(W)$ define $H=D^{\mathrm{op}}R$. For a cone $c$ over $D$, define $B=R(c^{\mathrm{op}})$, with point $P_{c.\mathrm{pt}}(U)$ and leg $r_{c_i}$. These are explicit constructions, not chosen colimit witnesses.
